title: Marketplace Orders Damaged-Arrival Allowance on Late Deliveries
content:
**Guidance rule.** The damaged-arrival allowance of the Marketplace Orders late-delivery compensation looks at the return requests on the order: an order carrying a return request whose reason is damage in transit earns the transit-damage allowance of USD 4.00; an order carrying no such request but a return request for another seller-fault reason (defective, wrong item, not as described, missing parts) earns the seller-fault allowance of USD 2.00; any other order earns no damaged-arrival allowance.

The allowance is added in full to the late-delivery compensation owed on the order. It is not owed on an order that is owed no late-delivery compensation.

## Judgement by the order's return requests

| Return requests on the order | Allowance (USD) |
|---|---|
| at least one with reason damaged in transit (whatever other requests exist) | 4.00 |
| none for damage in transit, at least one for defective, wrong item, not as described or missing parts | 2.00 |
| only requests for other reasons (no longer needed, better price found, ordered by mistake), or no return request | 0.00 |

The allowance is paid once per order whatever the number of qualifying requests.

### Hypothetical cases

1. An order with one return request for damage in transit and one for defective: USD 4.00.
2. An order with a single return request for missing parts: USD 2.00.
3. An order with a single return request for ordered by mistake: no allowance.
